verdict.rationale: uv's docs say it is "disk-space efficient, with a global cache for dependency deduplication" (uv-docs-33) and that it caches aggressively so dependencies are not re-downloaded or rebuilt (uv-docs-25). A community user also reports uv fixed cache disk-space problems on a shared server (uv-comm-7). One user reports uvx sometimes re-downloading dependencies another tool had just fetched (uv-comm-4); this is an anecdotal caveat, not a concrete contradiction of deduplication, so it lowers confidence only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the store is content-addressable, details of how cached packages are linked into each project's environment (e.g., hardlinks) so one copy serves all projects, and independent hands-on confirmation of cross-project single storage.
